### L1 review (#35020) · 2026-11-18T06:48Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: facd9cb9985c923a3a966f059237611220cee6a6

This is the first L1 on this PR. I read the full diff against the merge-base `958ee03594`: 3 files, +90/−5. I also read the card, the claim 6970115817 and the os-dev report 6971035107.

**The fix, read against the card's 要做的.**
- Item 1. `currentId` is now elected over the whole tree by `resolveActiveNavItem`, whether or not the menu is open. `currentBehindMore` is true when that row holds no bar cell (it is not among `entries`) but is drawn in the full menu (`drawnNavigationEntries(items, guards)`, the same walk the bar takes its four entries from). More then gets `text-primary` and `aria-current="true"`.
- At most one cell lights. With the menu closed, either the cell for `activeId` lights or More does, never both. With the menu open, `activeId` is `null`, More is lit for the open menu as before, and `moreMarksPage` is false, so no `aria-current` is set.
- A page no drawn row addresses lights nothing. The drawn-row guard keeps More from promising a selected row the menu does not have.
- Item 2 (the full menu selects the current row) was measured as already met on `main`: with the bar assertions removed, the item-2 legs passed 2 of 2. It is pinned here, not changed, and `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` is untouched.
- The fence holds. `phoneNavBarEntries` (pins first, else the first four) is unchanged, and nothing reorders by recent use.

**Shape and scope.**
- `Fixes #35020` is on the first card line, with no closing keyword next to another open card. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` match the diff: no export, no spec, no metadata key.
- Declared deviation: the claim said "new test file(s) named for this card", but the pins went into the existing `UnifiedSidebar.phoneNavBar-34594.test.tsx` harness as a new top-level describe named for #35020. That follows the shared-harness rule, and the report says so. I accept it.
- No `content/docs/releases/` change and no unrelated file. `check-governed-merges --pr 35130`: not governed, 95 changed lines. No L2 is owed.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/35020-phone-bar-more-active.md` is new and edits no changeset on main. It bumps `@object-ui/app-shell` (private) as `patch`. App-shell-only changesets already on main follow the same pattern (e.g. `33826-deleted-record-leaves-recents.md`), and `updateInternalDependencies` carries the bump to its dependents. I checked its sentences against the diff:
- "More is now highlighted on such a page, and the full menu it opens shows that entry selected" matches `moreMarksPage` and the item-2 pin.
- "On a page whose entry is one of the four, that cell is highlighted as before and More is not" matches the Leads pin.
- "A page that no menu entry addresses highlights no cell" matches the two CONTROL rows (an undrawn entry, and no entry).
- "Which four entries the bar holds is unchanged" matches the untouched `phoneNavBarEntries`.

**Tests and evidence.**
- Pins: two acceptance-1 rows (pins push the page's entry off the bar, and the page is the fifth entry with nothing pinned), each asserting More alone is lit, `aria-current="true"`, no `aria-current="page"` in the bar, and the full menu selecting exactly that row; the Leads row; and two CONTROL rows.
- The premise was measured red with the pins committed alone: 2 failed, the acceptance-1 rows.
- Ablation (1), More lit only while open: 2 red. Ablation (2), drawn-row guard dropped: 1 red (the undrawn-entry CONTROL). Both were restored to blob == HEAD.
- 33 nearby layout files passed 183/183 and the app-shell type-check passed. The rest of the app-shell suite was declared to CI, and CI's Test UI is green on all 16 shards.

**CI at this head**, read from check-runs (52): 39 success, 13 skipped, none failed, none in progress.

#### Must-fix
None.

#### Should-fix
None.

#### Notes
- **N1.** More takes `aria-current="true"` while the links keep `"page"`. The PR says why (the button is where the page lives, not a link to it), and a screen reader announces it as current. I accept it.
- **N2.** `drawnNavigationEntries(items, guards)` now runs a second time per render, beside `phoneNavBarEntries`'s own walk. That is cheap at menu sizes. If the bar ever re-renders on scroll, the walk could be shared.
- **Landing.** Nothing more is owed from L1, and no L2 is owed.
